shared.decision: what the objective is during the bulk of the search
shared.everyone: the exact ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2/(||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf), with the max handled by argmax gradient or a logsumexp/beta-softmax surrogate
alternatives: optimise a p-norm surrogate ||f*f||_p for large finite p and only anneal to the max at the very end
optimise a different functional entirely (e.g. maximise the flat-band width of f*f above a threshold, or minimise the r…

shared.decision: search paradigm for escaping local optima
shared.everyone: local gradient-based descent (L-BFGS-B) plus hand-designed perturbation/homotopy moves (prune/revive, tilts, halo growth, beta ladders)
alternatives: population/evolutionary search over many candidate arrays with crossover of support structure
simulated annealing or basin-hopping with a Metropolis acceptance criterion on R

shared.everyone: fix or progressively prolongate a single 1-D grid, optimising at that resolution (coarse-to-fine halving or cumulative-mass prolongation)
alternatives: optimise on a continuously moving/adaptive mesh where knot positions are free variables (true knot-space, not just heig…
multi-resolution simultaneous optimisation: optimise coarse and fine representations jointly with a coupling penalty

shared.everyone: keep a fixed active set of positive cells during each L-BFGS call, with zeros either frozen or revived by small epsilon perturbations
alternatives: allow exact zeros to be created and destroyed continuously via a smoothed L0/L1 sparsity penalty inside the objective
represent the support explicitly as a union of intervals whose endpoints are optimised

shared.everyone: treat the array as fully general (asymmetric) and let the optimiser discover any symmetry
alternatives: impose even symmetry f(x)=f(-x) or a specific reflection structure and optimise only half the array
impose a unimodal or log-concave envelope constraint and optimise within that class

shared.decision: how the peak constraint is enforced
shared.everyone: softmax/logsumexp surrogate with a beta schedule, or exact argmax gradient, on the discrete knot values of f*f
alternatives: enforce the peak via an explicit constraint (e.g. augmented Lagrangian on max(f*f) = 1) rather than a penalty/surrogate
use a smooth maximum over a windowed average of f*f knots rather than the pointwise max

shared.everyone: a single fixed CPU-time budget split by hardcoded fractions among polish, ladder, and hop phases, with deadline checks
alternatives: adaptive budget allocation driven by observed marginal gain per phase (multi-armed bandit over move types)
restart-from-scratch many short independent runs and keep the best, rather than one long deepening run

shared.decision: what the objective is during the bulk of the search
shared.everyone: the exact ratio R = ||f*f||_2^2/(||f*f||_1 ||f*f||_inf), with the max handled by argmax gradient or a logsumexp/beta-softmax surrogate
alternatives: optimise a p-norm surrogate ||f*f||_p for large finite p and only anneal to the max at the very end
optimise a different functional entirely (e.g. maximise the flat-band width of f*f above a threshold, or minimise the r…

shared.decision: search paradigm for escaping local optima
shared.everyone: local gradient-based descent (L-BFGS-B) plus hand-designed perturbation/homotopy moves (prune/revive, tilts, halo growth, beta ladders)
alternatives: population/evolutionary search over many candidate arrays with crossover of support structure
simulated annealing or basin-hopping with a Metropolis acceptance criterion on R

shared.everyone: fix or progressively prolongate a single 1-D grid, optimising at that resolution (coarse-to-fine halving or cumulative-mass prolongation)
alternatives: optimise on a continuously moving/adaptive mesh where knot positions are free variables (true knot-space, not just heig…
multi-resolution simultaneous optimisation: optimise coarse and fine representations jointly with a coupling penalty

shared.everyone: keep a fixed active set of positive cells during each L-BFGS call, with zeros either frozen or revived by small epsilon perturbations
alternatives: allow exact zeros to be created and destroyed continuously via a smoothed L0/L1 sparsity penalty inside the objective
represent the support explicitly as a union of intervals whose endpoints are optimised

shared.everyone: treat the array as fully general (asymmetric) and let the optimiser discover any symmetry
alternatives: impose even symmetry f(x)=f(-x) or a specific reflection structure and optimise only half the array
impose a unimodal or log-concave envelope constraint and optimise within that class

shared.decision: how the peak constraint is enforced
shared.everyone: softmax/logsumexp surrogate with a beta schedule, or exact argmax gradient, on the discrete knot values of f*f
alternatives: enforce the peak via an explicit constraint (e.g. augmented Lagrangian on max(f*f) = 1) rather than a penalty/surrogate
use a smooth maximum over a windowed average of f*f knots rather than the pointwise max

shared.everyone: a single fixed CPU-time budget split by hardcoded fractions among polish, ladder, and hop phases, with deadline checks
alternatives: adaptive budget allocation driven by observed marginal gain per phase (multi-armed bandit over move types)
restart-from-scratch many short independent runs and keep the best, rather than one long deepening run

shared.decision: search paradigm for escaping local optima
shared.everyone: local gradient-based descent (L-BFGS-B) plus hand-designed perturbation/homotopy moves (prune/revive, tilts, halo growth, beta ladders)
alternatives: population/evolutionary search over many candidate arrays with crossover of support structure

shared.everyone: fix or progressively prolongate a single 1-D grid, optimising at that resolution (coarse-to-fine halving or cumulative-mass prolongation)
alternatives: optimise on a continuously moving/adaptive mesh where knot positions are free variables (true knot-space, not just heig…
multi-resolution simultaneous optimisation: optimise coarse and fine representations jointly with a coupling penalty

shared.everyone: keep a fixed active set of positive cells during each L-BFGS call, with zeros either frozen or revived by small epsilon perturbations
alternatives: allow exact zeros to be created and destroyed continuously via a smoothed L0/L1 sparsity penalty inside the objective
represent the support explicitly as a union of intervals whose endpoints are optimised

shared.everyone: treat the array as fully general (asymmetric) and let the optimiser discover any symmetry
alternatives: impose even symmetry f(x)=f(-x) or a specific reflection structure and optimise only half the array
impose a unimodal or log-concave envelope constraint and optimise within that class

shared.decision: how the peak constraint is enforced
shared.everyone: softmax/logsumexp surrogate with a beta schedule, or exact argmax gradient, on the discrete knot values of f*f

use a smooth maximum over a windowed average of f*f knots rather than the pointwise max

shared.everyone: a single fixed CPU-time budget split by hardcoded fractions among polish, ladder, and hop phases, with deadline checks
alternatives: adaptive budget allocation driven by observed marginal gain per phase (multi-armed bandit over move types)
restart-from-scratch many short independent runs and keep the best, rather than one long deepening run
